title: A 40 mm tatami square at PE-DESIGN's defaults, Stitch Type button 2
description: A 40 x 40 mm Fill Stitch square at PE-DESIGN 11.50's defaults (density 4.5, direction 45, step pitch 4.0 mm, Frequency 30 %, pull 0, under sewing off) with Stitch Type button 2. Issue #123: PE-DESIGN has no random stagger; its only stagger controls are Frequency (0-50 %, default 30) and the two Stitch Type buttons, which differ by 14 stitches on this square (2068 / 2054). OpenStitch has no Stitch Type; both references are compared with the same fill.

evidence.note: compat/reference/stitches/tatami-40-stitch-type-2.pes (PE-DESIGN 11.50, 2026-10-29): 2054 stitches; Density field floor 0.1 lines/mm (0.05 -> 0.1, 0.15 -> 0.2, 0 -> 0.1), ceiling 14.0 (#139)

references.make: Shapes > Rectangle (10,10)-(50,50) mm (Size dialog 40 x 40), line Not Sewn, region Fill Stitch at the defaults with under sewing unticked, Stitch Type button 2. Save As PES (default type).
